site.name: the Dry Cistern
site.measured_gap: MEASURED 2026-10-03 (the grid of docs/world-building/CHALLENGERS_CAIRN.md 'Why here'): the second emptiest place in the south a player walks past was (4496, 5904), 296 blocks from the nearest authored thing (Hornwall's anchor, data/resident_encounters.json), 139 blocks off Route 8.
site.why_here: the brow of the Scorched Plateau's west tableland, where the ground rises from y155 on Route 8 to y161-166 (tools/ground.py, sampled every 3 blocks over x4506-4554, z5826-5874): a broad, gently tilted top with nothing on it, the high ground above the road. A cistern is what dry high country keeps, and the Rift is why it is dry.
site.findable_from: MEASURED 2026-10-03 (tools/dry_cistern.py --report): the lantern under the well-head's crossbar is in clear sight of a standing eye from Route 8's walked points (every 4th within 250 blocks); the report prints how many and the clearest.
site.off_path: the nearest walked point of Route 8 is 105 blocks from the whole write box (measured 2026-10-03 by the report). Nothing in data/placements.json, data/towns.json, data/landmarks.json, data/legendaries.json or data/habitat_blocks.json within 250 blocks; Tableland Stop's nearest record is about 400 blocks east; the Mega dens' nearest approach point (data/mega_dens.json, on Route 8 at (4507, 5696)) is a road point, about 150 blocks north-west, not a den.

chamber.why: a rock-cut cistern 9 by 7 and 5 high, its roof on four red sandstone pillars, carved the Ursaluna den's way (a shell filled solid `margin` blocks round every void, never in the top `keep_natural_top` block of a column, then the void cut out) and lined in red sandstone and terracotta. A band of white terracotta round the walls 3 above the floor is the old water line. The floor is dry.

passage.why: the keepers' stair, 3 wide, cut down from the west into the cistern's west end: roofed while it has two blocks of ground over it, an open trench between dressed red sandstone walls after that, with a red sandstone face over its mouth. It opens west, toward the road below the brow.

shaft.why: the draw-shaft the water was lifted by, at the cistern's east end: a one-block shaft from the chamber's roof up to the ground, a ladder on its east face, capped with a closed trapdoor in the ground's top block. Over it a well-head: two acacia posts and a crossbar, a lantern hanging from the bar, and a ring of red sandstone slabs (a half step, walked over).

house.why: the keeper's house beside the stair head, roofless and fallen: a 7 by 5 shell of terracotta and red sandstone whose walls stand 1 to 3 high by turns, a doorway in its south wall. An empty cauldron inside, and the keeper's sign.

lanterns.why: places are lit as towns (lanterns, never light blocks: docs/STATE.md): the lantern on the well-head, two hanging in the cistern, one in the roofed stair and one on each wall end at the trench's head.

find.why: a cache (data/rewards.json dry_cistern_store, ADR-002), granted once per player through tools/rewards_pack.py's advancement on reaching the cistern's east end; the barrel the pack places there is scenery. A Water Stone (the keepers kept one 'to keep the water sweet', the joke of a dry cistern) and two Heavy Balls (rock country's situational ball, docs/research/notes/reward-item-inventory.md section 4). The Water Stone is the reason it is here, on Route 8 before Giovanni: water is the answer to a ground team, and pillar 1 (docs/vision/GAME_VISION.md) asks for that answer to be findable in the region before the boss. It is optional; nothing on the critical path needs it.

blocks.rule: vanilla 1.21.1 only, none a spawn condition in data/spawn_blocks.json (tools/wayside_kit.py refuses the record otherwise; red_sand and sand ARE conditions and are not used), no chest, no bed.
